summary_en: Annual dividend for FY6/26 revised to ¥38.00/share (ordinary ¥36.00 + anniversary special ¥2.00), from prior forecast of ¥36.00/share. Interim ¥18.00/share (ordinary). Anniversary special commemorates 5th listing anniversary (July 15, 2025).
title_en: Notice of Dividend Forecast Revision (5th Listing Anniversary Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
On June 16, 2026, i Cubed Systems' board approved a revision to the dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2026 (FY6/26), announced on December 11, 2025.

The annual dividend per share has been raised from the prior forecast of ¥36.00 to ¥38.00. This comprises ordinary dividends of ¥36.00 per share (¥18.00 interim, ¥18.00 year-end) plus a special commemorative dividend of ¥2.00 per share paid at the fiscal year-end. The company marks its 5th anniversary of listing on July 15, 2025, and the special dividend is intended as an expression of gratitude to shareholders for their continued support during the company's growth since listing.
